title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet overhears Vodka's pre-race interview about her passion for the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Scarlet's own determination is renewed, and she swears she'll beat Vodka and become number one once more.
